info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Expires-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Expiration API provides insights into the loyalty points that are nearing expiration for hotel guests. By accessing this endpoint, businesses can retrieve a list of loyalty points that are scheduled to expire, enabling timely notifications to customers. This functionality is essential for loyalty program managers and marketers seeking to enhance customer engagement and retention strategies. Typical consumers include hotel chains and loyalty program administrators aiming to optimize point usage and elevate customer satisfaction.

get.description: Fetches a list of points that are nearing their expiration date. This endpoint is useful for users to manage their points effectively and avoid losing them.
